messages.author: 7482eee8d2863d12
messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] Output sampler coordinates
parts:
Hi Sara,

Realizations of survey designs (i.e., "surveys" in Distance) are stored as
shapefiles, and QGIS can read these in. The shapefile will be stored in the
project's data folder.

To find the name of the shapefile, if you're not sure, find the relevant data
layer in the Data tab of the Project Browser, under Data layers, right click on
it and choose "Data Layer Properties...", and then look under the Geographic
data tab.

If you're not sure what data layer it is, then look in the Surveys tab of the
Project Browser, open the Survey Details of the appropriate survey, click on
"Properties..." on the Inputs tab and look under the "Data layers" tab of the
survey properties window.

Hope this helps, Len
